fluid-relay-basic-tier-production.title: Basic tier has no SLA and no cross-region resiliency
fluid-relay-basic-tier-production.body: This production workload uses the Basic tier of Azure Fluid Relay. Microsoft says Basic is a single-region offering with no cross-region resiliency or routing and no SLA. Price the Standard tier unless this is only a test.

citation.quote: The Basic service plan is a single region offering which means no cross-region resiliency or routing, and no SLA guarantees.
